name: AI-MILO
instructions: AI-MILO is a Multimodal Interactive Learning Companion for CEFR English speaking practice.
Technology Stack: FastAPI + Uvicorn, Whisper ASR (local), ChromaDB (RAG), OpenAI/OpenRouter/Ollama via Bifrost LLM Gateway, Edge/OpenAI TTS, SQLite/PostgreSQL.
Knowledge Base: Managed as an Obsidian Vault under 'Knowledge Base MILO'. Ingest with 'python knowledge_base/ingest.py'.
Bifrost LLM Gateway: Configured in docker-compose.bifrost.yml on http://localhost:8080/v1 for token budgeting and rate-limiting.
Always run tests and verify imports with 'uv run' after modifications.
